Nepal is UTC+5:45.
Nepal adopted Indian Standard Time in 1920 and advanced its clocks by 15 minutes in 1986.
The Chatham Islands use UTC+12:45; Nepal UTC+5:45.
Spain uses Central European Time though it lies much further west.
Spain observed GMT from 1901; on 16 March 1940 at 23:00 GMT clocks moved to 00:00 CET.

North Korea switched from UTC+9 to UTC+8:30 (Pyongyang Time) on 15 Aug 2015.
The 2015 change marked the 70th anniversary of liberation from Japan; clocks were 30 minutes behind South Korea.
In May 2018 North Korea returned to UTC+9 to realign with South Korea, as a step toward unity.
